_comment: Expected-support matrix for access_mode=lf_fta. Full Table Access changes WHICH credentials reach S3 (Lake Formation vended for registered tables) but does not change Spark's table-provider capabilities, so the per-operation expectations are those of plain mode. Row/column/cell filters do not apply under FTA.
basis: Apache Spark capability by table provider. Hive/file-source (USING parquet) tables are Spark v1 tables: they support neither row-level DML nor the DataFrameWriterV2 API. Iceberg and Delta are v2 table providers and support both. FTA additionally requires EMR >= 7.8.0 (EMRFS) or >= 7.10.0 (S3A).

state_codes.S: SUPPORTED — uses Lake Formation credentials exclusively; no fallback to runtime-role credentials if LF permissions are insufficient
state_codes.S3: SUPPORTED_WITH_S3_IAM — does NOT use LF credentials; runtime role needs direct S3 IAM on the table location regardless of registration
state_codes.N: NOT_SUPPORTED — documented as unsupported; a failure here is expected behavior, not a regression

notes: FTA is enabled by job-level Spark configuration, not by an application switch, and cannot be combined with FGAC.
Jobs referencing tables that carry FGAC rules or Glue Data Catalog views fail under FTA; use FGAC mode for those.

UPDATE.caveat: row-level UPDATE is not supported on Spark v1 file-source tables

DELETE.caveat: row-level DELETE is not supported on Spark v1 file-source tables

MERGE_INTO.caveat: MERGE INTO is not supported on Spark v1 file-source tables

DF_WRITER_V2.caveat: DataFrameWriterV2 requires a v2 table; USING parquet produces a v1 table

ROW_FILTER.caveat: FTA grants whole-table access; filters do not apply
